feature_contract.goal: Carry genuine game-authored local DEFAULT GPU-only camera color source textures through the native D3D11 left/right eye capture and shared producer ring without CPU readback or made-up camera frames, preserving exact source generations, original D3D9Ex render/input/FFB and guarded OpenXR publication; this is a build-verified source stage, not a finished playable renderer.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The native capture_eye and producer source validation admit local bindless single-sample DEFAULT game-camera copies, including supported mip-zero array eye slices, and existing shared-eye CopySubresourceRegion/fence path.

Reject shared/UAV or multisampled bindless copies, wrong dimensions/device/format/slice/eye identity or invalid GPU transfer; preserve MSAA render-target resolve, exact fence/ACK identity, original D3D9Ex rendering/gamepad/FFB and frozen DXVK.

Final non-CI-skip exact source validation SHA passes unmodified DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD checks; stereo transport WARP and portable C++ positive/negative tests pass without an HMD gameplay claim.
